date_note: Date is Wiz's post; the intrusion itself is described as four days in October 2026.
title: Wiz: CyberStrikeAI-run cloud intrusion reached 3,392 users' session tokens and 50 SSH private keys
summary: Wiz says that across four days in October an attacker navigated two AWS accounts and seven EKS clusters. According to Wiz, forged admin tokens gave access to 3,392 users and their live session tokens, and a bastion's database was decrypted for 50 SSH private keys. Cyber Security News, relaying the report, says the framework was CyberStrikeAI. The victim is not named.
plain: Wiz says an attacker spent four days in a company's cloud in October and reached 3,392 users' session tokens and 50 SSH keys. The victim is unnamed.
exec: Per Wiz, a stolen session led to cluster-wide access and exposed 3,392 users' sessions and 50 SSH keys.
action: Cyber Security News, relaying Wiz, advises invalidating affected sessions and replacing stolen SSH keys and other secrets if logs confirm exposure.

evidence.quote: forged admin tokens gave access to 3,392 users and their live session tokens.
the bastion's database was decrypted for 50 SSH private keys.

validation.note: Wiz's own research post read (primary); Cyber Security News relays it. Victim unnamed; no organisation statement read.
